observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stage under a tent at a festival or cultural competition, with seated audience in front
observation.dancers: large mixed group of young men and women in seated rows, with older leaders standing in the back row
observation.formation_and_space: multiple seated rows facing forward on a stage
observation.posture: seated cross-legged or kneeling upright on the stage floor with erect torsos
observation.footwork: seated posture; feet are not used for stepping as dancers perform sitting down
observation.arms_and_hands: synchronized upper body movements including clapping, extending arms forward and to the sides, and expressive hand gestures
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip movement; torsos remain upright with occasional gentle swaying or leaning synchronized with arm choreography
observation.partnering: none, all dancers perform individual synchronized movements within the group
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level entirely seated; no jumps or turns visible
observation.costume_and_props: white tops with dark skirts or wrappers, decorative bead or shell necklaces, and white feather headdresses/hair ornaments
observation.cannot_infer: footwork and lower body movements are occluded by seated positioning

signature_moments.what: Dancers clapping rhythmically in unison with hands held in front of their chests
Sweeping arm extensions moving from side to side in unison
